label: Ollama
setupNote: Install Ollama and download a model, for example: ollama pull qwen3. LocalPulse handles Ollama's browser-extension check for you.

label: LM Studio
setupNote: Load a model and start the local server in LM Studio's Developer tab.

label: llama.cpp server
setupNote: Start llama-server with a model. Don't use --tools or --agent: they block browser extensions.

label: Google Gemini
dataNote: Free tier: Google may use prompts and answers to improve its products, and human reviewers may read them. Google says not to send sensitive information.

label: OpenRouter
dataNote: Where your data goes depends on the model's provider. OpenRouter's privacy settings can exclude providers that train on data.

label: Groq
dataNote: Groq doesn't retain inference data by default. The free plan's small tokens-per-minute limit suits short pages.

label: Mistral
dataNote: On the free plan, Mistral may use your data for training unless you opt out.

label: Hugging Face
dataNote: Requests are routed to third-party inference providers, each with its own data terms.

label: Custom endpoint
setupNote: Any server that speaks the OpenAI Chat Completions API.
